fields.name: Barnard's Star
fields.description: Official test target. Highest proper-motion star in the sky (~10.4"/yr): ~1.9 SPHEREx pixels over the DR1+QR3 baseline.

fields.name: Epsilon Indi B
fields.description: Official test target. Pair of T brown dwarfs (Ba+Bb, unresolved at 6.15"/px) orbiting the bright star eps Ind A, ~402" away. ~1.1 SPHEREx pixels of motion over the baseline.

fields.name: R Draconis
fields.description: Official test target. Mira variable (period ~247 d) 8.6 deg from the north ecliptic pole: ~2,500 frames with nearly continuous coverage, the best light-curve case.

fields.name: RW Aurigae
fields.description: Official test target. T Tauri variable star: it does not move, it changes brightness. Compare season coadds or per-season spectra, not single exposures.

fields.name: WISE 0855−0714
fields.description: Official test target. Coldest known brown dwarf, ~2.3 pc away, ~8.2"/yr. Extremely red (J=25, W2=13.7): look at the longest wavelengths. Only DR1 data so far: ~1.4 SPHEREx pixels of motion.
